A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

Play a free virtual guitar online with your keyboard or by touch. Slow songs down and see every chord, string and strum. Acoustic, classic, electric and bass.

Why it drew attention

The collected source record shows 425 points, 108 comments, and published 2026-10-13.
